decisions.question: Should the steam locomotives get electrics, so they can take lamps, a cab light, a fridge and an outlet?
decisions.context: Batch 6 gave the Trains of the Rim steam engines only the crew water tank's bay: they have no electrical system, so electric fittings would have nothing to draw on. Big American steam engines like the Frisco 4-8-4 carried a steam turbo-generator for their headlamps (general knowledge, unverified).

options.label: A steam turbo-generator
options.detail: A small electrical system fed by the boiler's steam: dead when the fire is out, so the lamps and fridge run only in steam

options.label: Leave them
options.detail: Steam engines keep the water tank alone

decisions.why: It is how the real engines lit their lamps, and it ties the electrics to keeping steam up

decisions.question: The audit's new section finds the Dinghy and the Trawler with no water pump and no clutch. What should boats get?
decisions.context: Their cooling system names a radiator and a water pump, and their transmission a clutch, but the boat loadout binds none of them (the partly bound section, 28 Nov 2026). Marine engines are commonly cooled by sea water through a pump, and an inboard's gearbox has a clutch (general knowledge, unverified).

options.label: Pump on both, clutch on the Trawler
options.detail: A raw-water pump part on both boats and a clutch on the Trawler's gearbox; the radiator excused on boats in the audit

options.label: Excuse them in the audit
options.detail: Record boats as cooled by the sea with no parts for it

options.label: Later
options.detail: Leave the findings showing for now

decisions.why: A blocked or broken raw-water pump is the commonest real boat engine failure, so the part would change an outcome

decisions.question: Both M1A2 Abrams carry a turbocharger system with no turbocharger part. Look into it and take it off?
decisions.context: The partly bound section (28 Nov 2026) lists the turbocharger system on both M1A2s with nothing bound. The real tank runs on a gas turbine, which has no turbocharger; why the system is there was not read.

options.label: Look into it and fix
options.detail: Find why the system is added and take it off a turbine tank

options.label: Excuse it
options.detail: Record it as expected in the audit

decisions.why: A system with nothing to read shows readings for a part the tank does not have
